info.title: AgroSphere Estate Service
info.description: Milestone 1A. Estate-owned metadata; no geometry or operations. Bearer JWT must validate issuer, signature, lifetime and estate-service audience. Roles come from issuer-managed realm_access.roles; estate_ids is an issuer-managed UUID list. Only PLATFORM_ADMIN creates estates and clones. Managers/admins write assigned estates; viewers read assigned estates. Use current version on PUT/PATCH; stale versions return 409.
